---
request: Draft the term and termination article of a two-year SaaS agreement governed by Delaware law.
---
1. DEFINITIONS. "Effective Date" means the date both parties sign this Agreement.

2. TERM. This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and lasts two years.

3. TERMINATION. Either party may terminate on 60 days' written notice.

4. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware.
